user: `User` — `store/user.go` (line 29)

reaction: `Reaction` — `store/reaction.go` (line 7)

Each is the model type in package `store`, and the SQL in the dialect packages confirms the table mapping — `store/db/sqlite/user.go` inserts into `user`, `store/db/sqlite/attachment.go` into `attachment`, and `store/db/sqlite/reaction.go` into `reaction`, with parallel implementations under `store/db/mysql/` and `store/db/postgres/`. The table definitions themselves are in `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql` and its MySQL/PostgreSQL counterparts.

For context on the shapes:

```7:14:store/reaction.go
type Reaction struct {
	ID        int32
	CreatedTs int64
	CreatorID int32
	// ContentID is the id of the content that the reaction is for.
	ContentID    string
	ReactionType string
}
```

`Attachment` carries `Blob []byte` alongside `StorageType` and `Reference`, so the row holds either inline data or a pointer to external storage. Each file also defines the companion `Find*`, `Update*`, and `Delete*` parameter structs used by the `Driver` interface in `store/driver.go`.
